title: Conditions of Sale for Air Ticket Fare Brands: Price Drop Claims
content:
1. Application and defined quantities. These conditions apply to a ticket sold under Air Ticket Fare Brands and are read against the fare brand held on the booking.
 1.1 The claim window means the number of whole hours after ticket issue within which a lower public price may be claimed.
 1.2 The settlement ceiling means the highest amount payable on a single price-drop settlement on one booking.

2. The quantities by fare brand.

| Fare brand | Claim window after ticket issue | Cash settlement of a price-drop claim | Settlement ceiling for one booking |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0 hours | not permitted | 0.00 dollars |
| Economy Saver | 24 hours | not permitted | 0.00 dollars |
| Economy Classic | 24 hours | permitted | 150.00 dollars |
| Economy Flex | 48 hours | permitted | 250.00 dollars |
| Premium Economy Select | 48 hours | permitted | 300.00 dollars |
| Business Saver | 72 hours | permitted | 400.00 dollars |
| Business Flex | 72 hours | permitted | 600.00 dollars |

3. The claim window.
 3.1 The window is counted in whole hours from the issue of the ticket, and a claim brought after the window has run is not a claim within these conditions.
 3.2 On a hypothetical Economy Flex ticket issued at 09:00 on the third day of a month, a claim brought at 07:00 on the fourth day falls within the window of 48 hours; a claim brought at 15:00 on the fifth day falls outside it.
 3.3 Basic Economy Lite carries a window of 0 hours, and no period runs during which a lower public price may be claimed on it.

4. Settlement.
 4.1 A claim is settled in cash only on a fare brand for which cash settlement is permitted. On Basic Economy Lite and on Economy Saver it is not permitted, and the settlement ceiling on those brands stands at 0.00 dollars.
 4.2 No single settlement on one booking exceeds the ceiling of the fare brand held. A hypothetical Economy Classic claim that would otherwise settle at 190.00 dollars is settled at the ceiling of 150.00 dollars; the same claim on a Business Flex booking, whose ceiling is 600.00 dollars, is not reduced by this condition.
